name: text-neon-flicker
title: Neon Flicker-On
description: Chữ như ống đèn neon tắt, từng ký tự chập chờn sáng tắt không đều trong khoảng 0.6 giây rồi sáng hẳn, hắt ánh lên tường.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-neon-flicker, written here): Unlit: fill accent 82 % toward the background with a 1.2 px stroke at 60 %. Lit: colour + glows 4 / 11 / 19 / 40 px (CSS text-shadow, whitish core #fff4fb; demo blurs 18 / 8 / 3 px). Each char starts 80 ms after the previous (from 0.35 s) and steps through one of 3 seeded level patterns, e.g. 1 → 0.15 → 1 → 0.35 → 1 at 0 / 160 / 240 / 520 / 600 ms, then stays lit (<3 flashes/s). Wall glow: radial accent 22 % × average level. Off 3.0–3.25 s; loop 3.6 s. Params: glow: ba lớp sáng (4 / 11 / 19 px, thêm 40 px) · stagger: giữa các ký tự (0.08 s) · flicker (0.5–0.66 s) · wall: hắt sáng tường (22 %). Under three flashes a second; each letter settles lit after about 0.6 s.
